beam_implementation.measurement_note: Reference measurements were collected before packaging. The timed replay and serving recipe are preserved.

beam_differences: 4 GB300 GPUs; TP4/EP1 or TP4/EP4; one tokenizer worker and HTTP/1.1
Draft8 with simulated acceptance4 and real draft tokens
Native KV dtype; context1048576; HiCache88 at cc>=16
Beam Harmony history normalization and per-request usage validation
Pinned dataset revisions, independent resource guards, fresh server per point
reference_code_origin: The dataset builder and client dependency freeze originated in the Muse benchmark; the Beam replay adapter, validation and guarded driver were adapted for Beam. No Muse serving patches or connection-balancing retries are applied.
